messages.subject: Project Vertex - board approval Wednesday
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our board meets Wednesday 24th at 2pm to approve the licence and assignment. Could you and Sarah dial in for the Project Vertex item? I'll circulate the board minutes for signature straight after. Please confirm the final upfront and cap so I can put accurate resolutions in front of them.

Naomi

messages.subject: RE: Project Vertex - board approval Wednesday
messages.plaintextBody:
Naomi,

Sarah and I will join for the item. Final agreed terms: upfront £6.5m (within 7 business days), milestones to £54m, royalties 6/9/12%, liability cap 9 months, cure period 45 days, retained rights limited to internal research only. The FTO report and Disclosure Letter are final. Those figures are safe for the resolutions.

James
